dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit a diffuse gradient transition from dark-charcoal exterior perimeters to light-grey interior fields. Perimeter geometry is irregular and non-uniform across the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Isolated high-intensity pixel clusters are sparse. There is a high spatial density of small, asymmetrical, low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters localized within the centers of the light-toned macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three primary macro-annuli on the upper lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary chain of smaller centroids follows a curvilinear path from the mid-section toward the posterior caudal region.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, light-toned crescent marking located in the periocular region; five distinct, dark-toned, curved ungual processes (claws) are clearly visible on the distal portion of the pectoral flipper.
